gate3_single_model.statement: HardwareIOModel is the sole tree for Hardware UI; adapters/modules/channels in this trace are the same objects.

root_cause_fix.statement: _configio_desc_claim treated PANEL-NODE / PANEL-CATALOG Desc (e.g. CP5-NODE51-1A, CP2-1794-IA16-3) as occupied; those forms are module topology addressing only. Unused bits on mapped modules are PROVEN_SPARE (CONFIGIO_MAPPED_UNUSED_BIT), not UNRESOLVED_OWNER.
